passages.sermon: This is a song for going up to Jerusalem.\r\nPeople sang this song as they traveled to worship God.\r\nThe song is called a "song of ascents."

passages.text: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
The song speaks to all people who fear the LORD.
The LORD is God.
The song also speaks to those who walk in the ways of the LORD.
All people who fear the LORD are blessed.
All people who walk in the ways of the LORD are blessed.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃

passages.text: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
passages.sermon:
You work hard with your hands.
You eat what you earn.
You are blessed.
Good things come to you.
passages.original: יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
passages.sermon:
This psalm describes the blessings for a man who fears the LORD.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine.
She will flourish inside your house.
Your sons will be like young olive shoots.
They will sit around your table.
passages.original: אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
passages.sermon: A man fears the LORD.\r\nGod blesses this man.\r\nGod gives blessing in this way to every man who fears Him.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־ כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life, that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gives blessings from Zion.
May the LORD bless you from Zion.
You will see good things in Jerusalem.
You will see the prosperity of Jerusalem.
You will see this all the days of your life.
You will see your children’s children.
Peace will be upon Israel.
passages.original: יְבָרֶכְךָ֥ יְהוָ֗ה מִצִּ֫יּ֥וֹן וּ֭רְאֵה בְּט֣וּב יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃ וּרְאֵֽה־ בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
